description: AixCaliBuHA automates sensitivity analysis and parameter calibration for building and HVAC models. RWTH Aachen University publishes the Python software to connect selected tuning parameters, calibration classes and objective functions in a repeatable workflow. Users still define the physical model, inputs, measured outputs and experiments. Geographic coverage, calibration period and sampling resolution therefore follow the supplied model and observations. GitHub hosts source code and documentation, with installation through PyPI and a notebook tutorial. The repository states MIT, allowing free reuse. Documentation also describes guided setup for Modelica models. A central limitation is that calibration cannot repair an unsuitable model structure or flawed experiment; the README explicitly asks users to evaluate those assumptions. The package can support fitting and comparison of building-system models before scenario analysis. Related record model-energyplus provides a building simulator, but this review did not verify an interface to it. No optimisation or calibration example was run, and published accuracy claims were not independently tested.
